description: This Java source file defines the `InteropTransferRequestData` class, which extends `InteropRequestData`. It models transfer request data in an interoperation context, including fields for transfer code, fees, and commissions, along with methods for validation and normalization. The class is part of the `org.apache.fineract.interoperation.data` package and relies on various utility classes and constants for processing JSON input.
